elections.dateBasis: Postal voting closed at 2 pm AEDT on 27 October 2026. TEC records a 3 November 2026 Hobart certificate issue date.

elections.label: 2026 Hobart Councillor election
elections.dateBasis: Postal voting closed at 2 pm AEDT on 27 October 2026. The final count returned nine councillors.

elections.label: 2026 Hobart Lord Mayor election
elections.dateBasis: Postal voting closed at 2 pm AEDT on 27 October 2026. Charles Wooley won the Lord Mayor contest with 55.04% in the final count.

candidates.name: Charles Wooley
candidates.result: Elected with 55.04% in the final count

elections.label: 2026 Hobart Deputy Lord Mayor election
elections.dateBasis: Postal voting closed at 2 pm AEDT on 27 October 2026. Ben Lohberger won the deputy ballot with 56.87% in the final count. He did not win a councillor seat and could not take up the office under section 41(4) of the Local Government Act 1993. Section 44(4) provides for the elected councillors to fill the vacant office.
